name: GROM Gaming
description: Polish engineered gaming peripherals for esports professionals.
story: GROM Gaming, founded by former Polish special forces veterans, brings military-grade precision and durability to the world of esports. They believe in supporting individuals who strive for peak performance, and see motorsport as a natural fit for their brand. They seek to enhance brand recognition on a global scale and showcase the reliability of their products in high-stress environments.
